defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.what: about 0.27 SOL stranded unrecoverably on the first attempt
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.cause: ephemeral keys generated in memory, over-funded roughly tenfold, then discarded when the run threw
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.fix: keys are written to a run directory outside every repository at mode 0600 and reused; funding cut to the measured minimum; every step made resumable
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.not_recovered: the stranded balance is gone and is not written off quietly

defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.what: a failed transaction was reported as a mysterious missing account
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.cause: connection.confirmTransaction resolves for a transaction that landed and failed; only the confirmation itself rejects. Swallowing that turned an on-chain error into 'the account it should have written never became readable'
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.fix: the helper now fetches the transaction and raises with its logs

defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.detail: it accepts rentPayer, adds it to the signer list, and never passes it to the instruction builder, so the account rent is charged to the creator regardless. A creator holding nothing therefore fails with 'insufficient lamports 0'
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.fix: the instruction is built directly, where rentPayer is honoured
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.upstream: not reported upstream; recorded here so a reader hitting the same wall does not have to find it twice

what_this_does_not_establish: no release has ever executed on a public cluster and none can before 2028: the 730-day cliff, the 30-day notice, the 90-day rotation notice and the silence grace all need time control a public cluster does not have. What they produce here are refusals
the aggregate market-capacity rule was not exercised, for the same reason: it binds at release time
all three multisig members were generated by the probe, so this is survival of key loss and not independence. A committee of keys one person holds is one person
devnet is subject to ledger resets; this receipt is not a permanent object
no independent party has run or reviewed any of it, and there has been no security review of B2, of Squads, or of their interaction
no mainnet, no production key, no production ceremony
